== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[FX-10 (Effex-ten) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|FX-10 (Effex-ten)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100669 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100669], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100669-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>a26149d17e99e3b4b6205f6dde649963b4d7e1dbe76680e0a3d28d4ba0e13b52</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
